subject: Subject
lineLabel: {line}: add a person or an address
placeholder: A contact of {party} or an address

who.from: From you, with this record's reply address, so the answer lands back here.
who.correction: A correction of a mail you sent: the old one stays and says “Corrected below”.
who.undo: After Send you have 10 seconds to take it back.

check.checking: Checking the recipients and the text…

held.refused: Go back: this message cannot go from here
held.officeFile: Share or take off the office-only file first
held.outside: Tick “Send outside this customer”, or take the address off

problem.forbidden: You may not send mail for this record.
problem.notFound: This record is no longer there.
problem.unavailable: Nexus cannot be reached right now. You can still send: the factory refuses another customer's address on its own.
problem.failed: The check did not run. You can still send: the factory refuses another customer's address on its own.

outside.title: {addresses}: another customer’s address.
outside.body: This mail is about {party}’s record. It is refused unless you tick below; the tick is recorded with your name.

OTHER_ORGANISATION.title: Another organisation gets it: {items}.
OTHER_ORGANISATION.body: Check that it may read {party}’s mail.

UNKNOWN_RECIPIENT.title: Not a contact of {party}: {items}.
UNKNOWN_RECIPIENT.body: Check the address before it goes.

INTERNAL_MENTION.title: The text mentions a colleague: {items}.
INTERNAL_MENTION.body: Mentions stay in office notes; {party} would read it as plain text.

OFFICE_FILE.title: Office only: {items}.
OFFICE_FILE.body: Share it with {party} or take it off before it goes.

notice.sent: Sent to {party}: the delivery word shows on the message.
notice.failed: Not sent: {reason}. Your text is still in the box.
notice.outside: An address belongs to another customer: the mail did not go. Take it off, or tick “Send outside this customer” in the check.
notice.hidden: A blind copy goes only to our colleagues or to this customer's contacts: the mail did not go.
notice.badRecipient: Not sent: an address was refused (not valid, or it bounced or complained before). Fix the address and send again.
notice.takenBack: Taken back: the mail did not go. Your text is back in the box.
notice.undoFailed: The mail could not be taken back: Nexus could not be reached. It may already have left.

undo.NO_WINDOW: Not taken back: this mail went at once, without the 10 seconds to undo it.
undo.LEFT: Not taken back: the mail has already left.
undo.NOT_SENT: Not taken back: the mail did not go, so there is nothing to undo.
undo.NOT_YOURS: Not taken back: only the person who sent this mail can undo it.
